planets.name: WASP-75 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-75 with a 2.48-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: WASP-75 b was found in 2013 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-75. Its orbit and size follow Gomez et al. 2013's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname GOMEZ_ET_AL__2013): disc_year 2013, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.4841976, pl_radj 1.27, pl_bmassj 1.07
